info.title: Regions API - Retrieve World Regions & Subregions
info.description: Retrieve all geographical regions supported by the GeoDB service. Returns a flat array of exactly 6 region names - Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania, and Polar. This endpoint takes no required parameters, ignores unrecognized query parameters rather than erroring, and has no documented error responses. Use the returned region names with the Subregions endpoint to drill down into subregional data.

get.description: Returns all geographical regions supported by the service, such as Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania, and Polar.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

200.description: Successful response with list of regions

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

RegionsResponse.description: Response containing the flat list of geographical regions supported by the GeoDB service.

regions.description: An array of region names representing all geographical regions supported by the service.
